$comment: Acknowledged, issue-referenced exceptions to scripts/check-qualification-record-required.mjs (issue #863): a package version that merged to main ahead of its retained qualification record, with a reason and a tracking issue. Modelled on the `gaps` mechanism in docs/contracts/package-evidence.json / scripts/check-package-evidence.mjs. This is a countdown, not a standing exemption -- the gate refuses to let an entry outlive its reason: once a retained, matching record exists for the exact package@version an entry names, the entry is stale and the gate fails until it is removed and its issue closed.

deferrals.reason: The record could not be produced on the developer machine: scripts/lib/release-runtime.mjs pins the qualification runtime exactly (Node v24.19.0, npm 11.17.0, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley-3246f1b) and this machine runs node v24.15.0, npm 11.12.1, zlib 1.2.12. The pin is correct and must not be relaxed - a qualification record exists to prove exact artifact bytes, and bytes produced by a different toolchain prove something else. The candidate packs cleanly from a clean rm -rf dist rebuild and the public registry is reachable; only the toolchain version blocks it. Same cause as the inspector instance this issue was opened for, and distinct from the intercepted-egress sandbox class in #833. This acknowledges a merge, never a publication: 0.9.8 may not be published before the record exists.

The qualification runtime is pinned exactly (scripts/lib/release-runtime.mjs: Node v24.19.0, npm 11.17.0, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley-3246f1b) and the developer machine that produced this version runs node v24.15.0, so run-candidate-qualification.mjs refuses before it packs anything. The pin is right -- a record made on a different toolchain proves different bytes -- so the record is owed from a machine or workflow running the pinned runtime, not from a relaxed gate. Unrelated to #833, which is about intercepted egress in a cloud sandbox; here the registry is reachable and only the runtime differs.

This version was cut in a cloud sandbox whose outbound HTTPS is intercepted and re-terminated (issue #833). scripts/run-candidate-qualification.mjs is owner/developer-machine work in that sandbox class: sanitizedEnv() does not forward a parent CA-trust variable, and a qualification record exists to prove exact artifact bytes rather than bytes observed through an interception path. 0.9.9 may not be published before the record exists.
